notes: Ground truth was written by reading the source files directly, not by looking at retriever output.
expectedFiles are repo-relative paths (same strings as chunk metadata.source).
Convention: when a question names an entity defined in the repo (a function, middleware or model), its defining file is included alongside the files that use it.
Set status to "reviewed" after checking every item; runEval.js refuses official runs on a draft.

All 20 items were re-verified against the source with grep (file, line numbers and completeness of file lists). c03 was rewritten because model/Comment.js was not needed to answer the original wording.

questions.question: How is a user's password hashed before it is stored in the database?
questions.evidence: model/User.js:20-25 pre('save') hook runs bcrypt.genSalt + bcrypt.hash

questions.question: How does the server verify a JWT and reject requests that are not authenticated?
questions.evidence: middleware/authMiddleware.js:3-18 reads Authorization header, 401 if missing, jwt.verify in try/catch

questions.question: What happens when a user logs in with an email and password?
questions.evidence: controller/authController.js:29-43 findOne by email, bcrypt.compare, jwt.sign with 1h expiry

questions.question: How does the application connect to MongoDB and what happens if the connection fails?
questions.evidence: config/db.js:3-13 mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGO_URL); on error logs and process.exit(1)

questions.question: Who is allowed to delete a comment?
questions.evidence: routes/commentRoutes.js:67 comment author or the post's creator; otherwise 403

questions.question: How does editing an existing post work and what authorization check is done?
questions.evidence: controller/postController.js:65-85 modifyPost checks postToEdit.creator != req.user.id, then updates content

questions.question: What fields does a comment have in the database schema?
questions.evidence: model/Comment.js:5-10 content, authorID, postID, likes[], timestamps

questions.question: Which URL prefixes are the different route groups mounted under in the app?
questions.evidence: server.js:28-32 /auth, /posts, /comments, /follow, /review

questions.question: What does routes/followRoutes.js import?

questions.question: Which files import the User model?
questions.evidence: require of model/User or ./User in the 10 importer files listed; routes/authRoutes.js and server.js do not import it. 11 expected files > k=5, so recall@5 is capped at 45%

questions.evidence: middleware/authMiddleware.js:11. Deliberately hard: verify is a library function, not defined in the repo, so the graph has no definition node for it

questions.question: How does a request to create a post flow from the route to the database?
questions.evidence: postRoutes.js:17 -> protect -> postController.createPost (23-41) -> new Post / save; schema in model/Post.js

questions.question: How is the feed of posts built for a user, and how do public and private accounts affect it?
questions.evidence: postController.js:89-124 getAllFollowingPosts merges following + users with account 'Public'; account enum in model/User.js:15

questions.question: How is a comment linked to its post and its author in the data model, and what code keeps both sides in sync when a comment is created?
questions.evidence: sync code: routes/commentRoutes.js:32-33 ($addToSet on Post.comments and User.comments); references: model/Comment.js:7-8 (authorID, postID), arrays: model/Post.js:8 and model/User.js:12 (comments)

questions.question: How does a logged-in user's token get checked on protected endpoints after login?
questions.evidence: token issued authController.js:38; verified middleware/authMiddleware.js:5-12 and attached as req.user
